name: Iron Shaft
summary: The Iron Shaft is a metallic segment of Dartol's Rod, a relic Raene Wolfrunner's friend Teronis sought in hopes of slowing the furbolg assaults on Ashenvale. Recovered from a locked chest near the border of Felwood, it serves as a crucial component in restoring the relic for the defenders of Ashenvale.

sections.title: A Piece of Dartol's Rod
sections.body: Dartol's Rod was the creation of Dartol, and its pieces were scattered across Ashenvale; one was even given to the druids of Dor'Danil for safekeeping. The Iron Shaft represents the sturdy metal core of the instrument, secured away inside a locked chest in a secluded glade near the northern border of Ashenvale, not far from the tainted realm of Felwood.

sections.title: The Forest's Blight
sections.body: Securing the Iron Shaft requires recovering its key from the local treants who once tended these woods. With the demonic corruption creeping southward from Felwood, ancient guardians such as the Crazed and Withered Ancients have lost their minds to madness. The dryad Shael'dryn tasks travelers with obtaining the shaft so the rod may be reforged and the task of the fallen Teronis completed.

faq.q: What is the Iron Shaft used for?
aliases: why do i need iron shaft
faq.answer: The Iron Shaft is a piece of Dartol's Rod, a broken relic. It is gathered so the dryad Shael'dryn can help reassemble the rod and finish the task of Teronis, who sought it to slow the furbolg assaults on Ashenvale.

faq.q: Where is the Iron Shaft found?
faq.answer: It is locked inside a chest located in a quiet glade west of the road leading toward Felwood, in the northern part of Ashenvale.

faq.q: How do you open the chest containing the shaft?
faq.answer: The chest requires a Wooden Key. This key is carried by the corrupted treants—the Crazed and Withered Ancients—wandering the woods northeast of Raynewood Retreat.

faq.q: Who is looking for the Iron Shaft?
faq.answer: Shael'dryn, a dryad stationed at a moonwell in central Ashenvale, directs adventurers to gather the pieces of Dartol's Rod as part of the effort to cleanse the forest.

angles.text: Recovering the Iron Shaft is a somber duty, as it requires putting down beloved forest treants who have fallen victim to the demonic blight seeping out of Felwood.
Reassembling Dartol's Rod touches closely upon druidic stewardship, using forgotten tools to heal wounded lands.
